title: Retirement Advisory Hub and Risk Classifier for Model Pinning
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a centralized 'Retirement Advisory Hub' in Console and associated automation that classifies risk for each model version and surfaces migration guidance and notice templates. The system should combine telemetry (pinned installs, active routes, error/latency regressions), contract/Committed Capacity data, and customer business-impact signals to prioritize communication cadence and provide per-customer migration playbooks. Outcome: fewer customer incidents during model sunsets and faster, measurable migrations to recommended model variants.
background: We currently publish deprecation notices and migration docs but lack a single place to see risk and prioritize outreach. Many customers pin versions and only discover sunset notices late, which triggers high-touch support and custom rollback requests. This ticket aligns onboarding/version-pinning tooling with performance profile publishing by adding risk scoring and tailored notices tied to telemetry and contract data.
proposed_solution: 1) Add a 'Retirement Advisory' tab in Console model-version pages showing a Risk Scorecard per version. 2) Implement a backend Risk Classifier that ingests: pin-telemetry, route volume, SLA tier, dedicated capacity commitments, observed regression deltas (latency/error/quality), and OSS usage. 3) Expose an API to generate per-customer migration playbooks and templated notices (email/console/contract). 4) Automate a staggered notification cadence (soft warning -> pin-warning -> final notice) based on risk bucket. 5) Create a small Ops dashboard for CS to see high-risk customers and recommended outreach actions.
acceptance_criteria: Risk Classifier computes a risk score (0-100) for any model version from historical telemetry and contract signals
Console shows Retirement Advisory tab with Risk Score, top 5 contributing signals, and automated notice preview
API can generate a per-customer migration playbook including recommended replacement model variants, backwards-compat adapters (if available), and estimated work effort
Automated notice cadence can be configured per-model and triggers notifications in Console and via email templates
CS/Ops dashboard lists top 50 high-risk customers and links to playbooks; at least one migration playbook was used in a pilot
Metrics instrumentation in place to track migration completion rate, ticket volume after first notice, and average time-to-migrate
steps: Design data schema for risk signals with Eng infra and Privacy team reviews
Prototype classifier using past sunset cases (historical tickets + telemetry) to validate features
Build Console UI (Retirement Advisory tab) mockups and review with CS and Docs
Implement backend ingestion pipeline and classifier; expose REST endpoints
Add templated notice generator and migration-playbook renderer
Run pilot with 3 low-risk model sunsets (internal + 2 opt-in customers)
Iterate on classifier thresholds and UI wording based on pilot feedback
Roll out to all model-version pages and enable Ops dashboard
risks: Risk classifier false positives could cause unnecessary high-touch outreach
Telemetry gaps for older model versions may undercount pinned customers
Complex contractual commitments for Dedicated customers may require legal sign-off per-customer
Automated notices need careful wording to avoid alarming customers and causing churn
success_metrics: Reduce emergency migration tickets within 30 days of sunset by 60%
Increase voluntary migration completion to recommended variants to 75% within 90 days
Decrease CS time spent per sunset by 40% for high-volume sunsets
No P0 incidents attributable to missed sunset notices in first 6 months after rollout
